name: Banana House And Wellness Centre

operating.quote: Yoga Teacher Training by Shri Gaia Institute 10th -24th November 2026

notes: Banana House is a boutique hotel in Shela, Lamu, whose site names it 'Banana House And Wellness Centre'. The site lists no gym hours, prices or facilities; pool and daily yoga appear only in guest reviews, which are not used.
The 8 AM to 8 PM hours on the contact page are for the reservation team, not the wellness centre, so no hours are set.
